actions.label: Run flows
actions.description: Run the product's flows across its matrix and write the report.
actions.agent: Run the declared flows across the matrix and write report/report.json with its findings, evidence and summary. Exit 1 when a check named by failOn fails.

out.label: Output folder
out.description: Where the report is written (default report).

shard.label: Shard
shard.description: k/n: run one shard of the units.

failOn.label: Fail on
failOn.description: any, none, or a comma list of checks that fail the run (default any).

only.label: Only
only.description: A comma list of checks to run (default all).

times.label: Times file
times.description: The per-unit times that balance the shards.

workers.label: Workers
workers.description: Matrix cells run side by side in one browser.

cells.label: Cells
cells.description: A comma list of cell key texts to keep, for a quick local run.

engine.label: Engine
engine.description: Browser engines every web flow runs on: chromium, webkit, msedge.

target.label: Target
target.description: What the flows run against, recorded in report.json's provenance.

targetVersion.label: Target version
targetVersion.description: The target's version, recorded in provenance.

headed.label: Headed
headed.description: Show the browser; refused outside CI.

evidenceMax.label: Evidence cap
evidenceMax.description: The most evidence to keep: bytes, KB, MB or none.

constrained.label: Constrained profile
constrained.description: Slow every page through DevTools, or off.

knownFailing.label: Known failing list
knownFailing.description: The list of cells that fail today, each with its issue.

report.label: Report folder
report.description: The folder the run wrote its report.json to.

actions.label: List units
actions.description: Print the units and how the shards split them, without running anything.
actions.agent: Print every unit the flows expand to and how shards split them. Runs nothing.

times.label: Times file
times.description: The per-unit times that balance the shards.

units.label: Units
units.description: The listed shards and their units.

actions.label: Merge reports
actions.description: Combine shard reports into one report.
actions.agent: Combine shard report folders into one report.json, checking that each expected unit ran exactly once. Exit 3 when a failing unit is missing or ran twice.

out.label: Output folder
out.description: Where the merged report is written (default report).

flows.label: Flows
flows.description: A glob of the flows whose units are expected.

failOn.label: Fail on
failOn.description: any, none, or a comma list of checks.

knownFailing.label: Known failing list
knownFailing.description: The list of cells that fail today.

report.label: Report folder
report.description: The folder the run wrote its report.json to.

actions.label: Record times
actions.description: Record each unit's time from reports, to balance the next run's shards.
actions.agent: Write each unit's measured time from the report folders to the times file, which the next run uses to balance shards.

out.label: Times file
out.description: Where the times are written (default flows/flow-review-times.json).

actions.label: Print summary
actions.description: Print the markdown summary of a report.
actions.agent: Print the markdown summary of report/report.json.

actions.label: Fold in judges
actions.description: Fold judges' rubric answers into the report.
actions.agent: Validate the judges' rubric answer files and fold them into report.json. Exit 2 when one is invalid.

merge.label: Merge
merge.description: Fold the rubric answer files named after it into the report.

report.label: Report folder
report.description: The report folder to update (default report).

report.label: Report folder
report.description: The folder the run wrote its report.json to.

actions.label: Check known failing
actions.description: Check that a known-failing list is valid and has not grown.
actions.agent: Check a known-failing list is valid. With base, exit 1 when it grew against the base list: the list only shrinks.

base.label: Base list
base.description: The base branch's list to compare against.

count.label: Count
count.description: Print how many entries the list has.

entries.label: Entries
entries.description: How many entries the list has.

actions.label: Validate flows
actions.description: Load and validate flows without running them.
actions.agent: Load and validate the flows named by the globs, printing one ok line per flow. Runs nothing.
